bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be 12" x 6" x 12" or smaller. All bags are subject to search.
allowed: Prescription medication in its original labeled container
bagPolicy.note: The size limit does not apply to the Picnic Series, but all blankets, chairs and other carried items are still searched. Prescription medication is allowed in a quantity for personal use during the event.

parking.note: Parking information is not explicitly detailed on the provided page. Visitors are encouraged to check the official website for updates on parking options and pricing.

rideshare.note: Use Crawford Circle outside the South Gates off Avenue of the Republic, or the North Gate on Georges Hill Drive. Check your rideshare app for the exact meeting pin.

concessions.note: The food and drink options at the Skyline Stage at the Mann include a variety of offerings, though specific details are not available from the provided content. Visitors can expect a selection of food stands and vendors catering to different tastes.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Request accessible, ADA-compliant tickets, including wheelchair spaces, folding-armrest aisle seats, and low-vision seats, through the Accessible Services Request form, which also takes ASL interpreter requests. Accessible parking is near the north and south entrances, first come, first served. KultureCity sensory bags are free to borrow with an ID at Guest Services on the Plaza near the South Gates.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted. The exception is Picnic Nights, when you can leave to return picnic items or chairs to your car.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is at the venue Ticket Office. Bring a valid photo ID and the credit card used for the purchase.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The Mann has a North Gate and a South Gate, and you can be dropped off in front of either gate or the Ticket Office. Accessible parking is near the north and south entrances, first come, first served.
